messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — EBR for NovaPay is locked in for Wed 3pm PT. Need final slide owners, top 3 renewal risks, and a polished demo path. Can people confirm owners by EOD today?
Miguel (CS Ops): I can take the capacity/usage slide and the renewal-signal chart. Will pull last 90d metrics. :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions Eng): I’ll own the onboarding status + enablement gaps slide. Need a short blurb from Product on roadmap impact (2–3 lines). @Samir can you ask Product?
Samir (Eng): Yup, I’ll ping Product now — ETA Mon EOD. Also can help with a short tech-risk note for the execs.
Elena (Acct Exec): I’ll prep the executive ask slide and the net-retention narrative. Heads-up: customer mentioned Tier-1 compliance concerns last week — that’s a potential renewal risk.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. Miguel, please highlight any unexpected burst billing anomalies. Elena, can you quantify the compliance concern (impact + ask)?
Elena (Acct Exec): Will do. Short ask: legal review + SOC status. I’ll draft 1-sentence ask and drop it here.
KB-Bot: Reminder: EBR prep doc created -> https://docs.internal/redwood/nova-ebrs/3912345678 — edit access for channel.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Putting slide owners into a quick slot so we can review Friday:
```
1. Exec ask: Elena
2. Onboarding status + gaps: Priya
3. Usage & costs: Miguel
4. Demo flow & fallback: Samir
5. Success metrics & next steps: Aisha
```
Can everyone confirm?
Miguel (CS Ops): Confirmed. I’ll attach the cost trend png by Thurs.
Samir (Eng): Confirmed for demo flow. Planning a 6-min primary demo + 2-min fallback. Will include a short script for the PM.
Aisha (CSM): Good. Two quick risks to call out for the execs: 1) Compliance backlog (Elena to quantify), 2) Demo stability on quantized model path (Samir to validate). Add a mitigation column.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Also recommend an enablement ask: 1-pager playbook for their support team. Can we include as an action item?
Aisha (CSM): Yes — Action item: produce support playbook draft. Owner: Priya. Due: Tue COB.
Elena (Acct Exec): I'll draft the exec ask and a short renewal health rubric. Drop in the doc by Mon noon.
Miguel (CS Ops): Small ask for slides: please keep visualizations <=1 chart/slide so we can hand off to design if needed.
Samir (Eng): FYI I’ll run the demo on a dedicated instance to avoid noisy neighbors. Will post the run link here before Friday.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks — last thing: capture customer feedback bullets (what they love / pain points) — we should surface 3 positives and 3 pain items. Everyone add one bullet each to the doc.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Added: "onboarding speed" + "API docs clarity" as positives, "edge-case auth flows" as a pain.
Miguel (CS Ops): Added cost anomaly example and latency spike on 3/7.
Elena (Acct Exec): Added customer quote about executive interest in predictable spend.
Aisha (CSM): Great. Quick recap of action items:
- Elena: Exec ask + compliance quant (Mon noon)
- Miguel: Usage/cost slide + chart (Thu)
- Priya: Onboarding slide + support playbook draft (Tue COB)
- Samir: Demo flow + stability validation + run link (Fri)
- Aisha: Compile slides, run dry-run Fri 11am PT
Please react :eyes: when you’ve completed your piece.
Samir (Eng): I reacted :eyes: — will post demo link by Thu EOD.
Miguel (CS Ops): Reacted.
Elena (Acct Exec): Reacted.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Reacted.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team — will send calendar invite for Fri 11am dry-run and a short pre-read 24h prior.
KB-Bot: Event created: "NovaPay EBR dry-run" Fri 11:00 PT — attendees channel: #customer-success.
Aisha (CSM): If anything else pops up, drop it here. Otherwise we’ll reconvene Fri 11 for a run. :rocket:
